APP INFO Built With Kotlin Multiplatform Designed for a seamless Android experience with iOS support planned. Version Current version 1.0.0 Data & API Use Uses Google Sign-In, Firebase Authentication, Firestore, Cloud Storage, and FCM. Smart Glucose Care, Simplified MedBuddy helps track glucose readings, monitor trends, and generate health insights. PERMISSIONS MedBuddy uses only the access needed for sign-in, sync, reminders, and health alerts. Notifications Used by Firebase Cloud Messaging for log reminders and health alerts. Device setting Internet Access Required for Google Sign-In, Firebase sync, Firestore, and Cloud Storage. Required Google Account Used to create your MedBuddy profile with name, email, and profile picture. On sign-in Your Privacy Matters You can view, update, or delete your health records and profile information inside the app. Your Data is Stored on Firebase Authentication, Firestore, Cloud Storage, and Firebase Cloud Messaging power account sync and reminders. Last updated: June 20, 2026. Tap to open the full policy online. - %1$s Information We Collect Account information: name, email address, and profile picture through Google Sign-In. Health data: blood glucose readings, meal periods, notes, age, weight, and blood type. Medical information: doctor names, specialties, hospitals, and appointment dates. How We Use Information Provide, maintain, and improve MedBuddy services. Track health trends and show dashboard visualizations. Send log reminders and health alerts through Firebase Cloud Messaging. Personalize greetings and theme preferences. Data Storage and Security MedBuddy uses Google Firebase Authentication, Firestore, and Cloud Storage to securely store and sync data across devices. Reasonable security measures are used to protect your information, though no security system is impenetrable. Third-Party Services MedBuddy uses Google Play Services and Firebase for core functionality. These services may collect information used to identify you. Your Rights You can view, update, or delete health records and profile information inside the app. You can sign out to stop syncing data to the cloud.
